name: Cdc Dental Clinic

summary_en: Located in Bangkok, Cdc Dental Clinic is a dental practice holding a 3.8 rating based on 3 reviews with a trust score of 43.7. The clinic has been referenced in 6 Pantip discussions, with community topics primarily focusing on toothache concerns and orthodontic updates.
